inference: Repeated fresh protocol-schema generation is the dominant profiled cost. The four local workloads do not establish an asymptotic wall-time law or production throughput.

next_bounded_optimization.target: Collision-free definition remapping within one fresh schema-inventory generation.
requirements: Preserve one fresh inventory on every existing protocol-integrity call; no cross-call authority or schema cache.
Prove exact canonical inventory equality with the current reference and retain the unmodified reference path for ambiguous or unsupported shapes.
Preserve original input snapshots, binding and model identity checks, post-render mutation checks, and all journal custody, cost, credit and release boundaries.
Run the relevant mutation/reference and original-file compatibility tests before comparing the same fixed four-case workload.

limitations: Synthetic unpromoted recovery trees, not complete audits or genuine provider evidence.
Reported child costs are synthetic journal invariants, not actual provider bills or private-ledger observations.
Verification is outside the measured stages; total experiment elapsed time is not a reported operation latency.
Provisional export measures the typed inventory, not full report or Markdown rendering.
Three repeated samples on each original tree are not independent cold-host repetitions; the host was not isolated.
Initial and resumed export timings vary materially in depth three; warm-state and host effects are not causally separated.
No Python 3.12, throughput, qualification, lineage, sealing, release or best-in-class claim.
